verdict.rationale: Omnara supports configurable approval gates ('you can decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input') and live progress following with corrections, which could be used to intercept before code changes, but there is no documented dedicated 'plan review/approval' step or spec-first workflow distinct from general action approval. missing for 10: explicit plan-generation/plan-approval workflow, evidence of blocking code execution until a plan is approved, and independent confirmation this is used for pre-code review.
